scalars.appr_root_cause: Stuck bill-payments are auto-generated (createdby = System) with nextApprover unassigned (-1): the approval workflow created the payment but never routed it to an approver, so it sits in 'Pending Approval' indefinitely. The bills themselves are Open (entered/approved) and awaiting these payments.
scalars.nodue_note: As of 04 Jul 2026 the no-due-date backlog is down to 14 bills (from 44 on 27 Jun) — the team fixed 30. All 14 remaining are Open + Approved, just missing a due date, so the KBank run skips them. Fix = re-apply the term to populate the due date; no re-approval needed.
scalars.prepay_note: Open bills on Prepayment terms — clear by applying the deposit, not the bank run. 8 bills (฿145,854) are >30 days past the bill date (ณัฐพล วันริโก ฿130k is the bulk).
scalars.pm_note: This account has NO NetSuite Vendor Prepayment (VPrep) module. Vendor deposits are booked to GL 11037002 เงินมัดจำ and cleared against bills two ways: netted inside the vendor bill, or applied to an AP bill via Journal. Both = a bill paid by prepayment (not by bank/KBank). Mostly fit-out/construction deposits (Subway, Juice Land, Very Thai, Pony On Wheel).
